lines.text: God shines forth from Zion with consuming fire before Him, summoning the heavens and earth to judge His people.
God calls His saints, who made a covenant by sacrifice, and does not rebuke them for their sacrifices.
God needs no bull from their stall or goats from their pens, for every beast of the desert is His.
God tells His people to sacrifice a thank offering, and if they call in trouble, He will teach them.
God tells the wicked they hate His instruction and slander their own brother, and that He will now rebuke them.
